Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Coverage of David Summers' death, with clips COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 2. Anita Bryant's anti-gay history discussed 3. ACLU votes to endorse the legalization of same-sex marriages 4. Ohio's Cuyahoga County Board of Commissioners bans job discrimination based on sexual orientation 5. Andy Humm on the Catholic Church's promotion of violence against homosexuals COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 6. Certain PBS stations decline to air documentary, "The AIDS Show," on the invisible effects of AIDS 7. Telephone poll in San Francisco shows the effects of AIDS on the gay community 8. California passes new law regulating the sale of "poppers" recreational drug 9. White House Drug Advisor finds that heavy marijuana use can make people gay COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 10. Sports Report 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. "Just Ask Raz" advice segment COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Clips from AIDS discussion on the People's Court 4. Interview with director, Rosa von Praunheim, regarding his film "A Virus Knows no Morals" COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 5. Second part of interview with calendar model, Andre Fiset COMMERCIAL: Paint-on tattoo kit COMMERCIAL: PFLAG condoms COMMERCIAL: GCN pledge drive, with Jack Wrangler
